old: The others poured their drink offerings to the blessed gods that live in heaven from where they sat,
new: The others poured their drink offerings from where they sat to the blessed gods that live in heaven,
reason: Edit 9 restored Butler's "the blessed gods that live in heaven" but left "from where they sat" after it, so a listener hears the gods sitting; Butler's "the others each from his own seat made a drink-offering" attaches the seat to the pourers, and moving the phrase keeps both.

old: She wanted to tell him everything herself, without
new: She also wanted to tell him everything without
reason: Butler gives two purposes of the fog, "so that people might not know of his having come, and that she might tell him everything without..."; the split sentence adds "herself" (not in Butler) and loses the link back to the fog, and "also" restores that link without adding anything.
Consistency with accepted Book 10 ¶17 'beech mast' (Butler 'beechmast'); lead decision after re-verification note.
